difficulty.instructions: How hard is the task to do well?
criteria: Easy: a short answer or a small edit
Moderate: a few files or steps
Hard: many files, debugging or design
Very hard: a long, open-ended or risky task

effort.instructions: How much reasoning should the agent spend on the task? Hard tasks need more.

criteria.high: High: careful reasoning for hard problems

weight.instructions: How much of a computer does doing the task take?
criteria: Medium: running tests or one build
Heavy: long builds, many processes or much memory

needs.instructions: What does the task need of the computer that runs it?

criteria.none: Nothing special: any computer with the repository's code can do it
criteria.apple: A Mac: the task builds, runs, tests, signs or ships software for Apple platforms (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Xcode, the simulator, TestFlight)
criteria.gpu: A GPU: the task trains or runs a model on a GPU, or runs GPU code

named_station.instructions: Does the person say where the work should happen? Saying it anywhere in the task counts: "run it on coderos", "on the Mac, update the changelog", "run the tests on coderos". A task whose subject is a computer (documenting it, describing its setup) or that mentions a kind of computer says nothing about where to work.

criteria.none: The person does not say which computer should do the work

named_engine.instructions: Does the person tell you which agent or model must do the task? Only a direct instruction counts, such as "use Codex" or "have Opus do it". A task that is about an agent, or mentions one, gives no instruction.

criteria.none: No instruction about which agent or model does the task, even when the task is about an agent or mentions one
criteria.claude: The person tells you to use Claude Code or Claude, or one of its models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable), to do the task
criteria.codex: The person tells you to use Codex, or a GPT model, to do the task
criteria.micro: The person tells you to use Microcoder to do the task
criteria.psionic: The person tells you to use a local model, or a model that runs on their own computer, to do the task

named_depth.instructions: Does the task itself ask, in so many words, for speed or for care?

criteria.none: The person says nothing about speed or care
criteria.faster: The person asks for a quick or short answer, or to spend less effort
criteria.more_careful: The person asks to think harder, take more care, be thorough, or use a stronger model
